# College Corridor — Admissions Advisory Platform

> College Corridor is India's premier student-first college admissions advisory platform. We guide students and parents through NEET UG & NEET PG medical counselling, B.Tech engineering admissions, MBA management admissions, Law admissions, and top university selections with 100% data transparency.

## About College Corridor
- **Tagline**: The No.1 MBBS & Higher Education Admissions Consultants | We Guide. You Decide.
- **Headquarters**: Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
- **Contact Phone**: +91 8194 083 803
- **Contact Email**: admissions@collegecorridor.com
- **Website URL**: https://collegecorridor.com

---

## Key Admissions Advisory Pathways

### 1. Medical & MBBS Admissions
- **NEET UG Admissions**: Guidance for All India Quota (AIQ 15%), State Quota (85%), Deemed Universities, Private Medical Colleges, and BDS/AYUSH seats.
- **NEET PG Admissions**: Specialization guidance across Radiology, General Medicine, Dermatology, Surgery, Paediatrics, Orthopaedics, and OBGYN.
- **URL**: https://collegecorridor.com/medical-admissions

### 2. Engineering Admissions
- **B.Tech & Entrance Exams**: Counselling for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, BITSAT, VITEEE, SRMJEEE, MET, and top state engineering universities.
- **URL**: https://collegecorridor.com/engineering-admissions

### 3. Management & MBA Admissions
- **B-School Selection**: Admissions advisory for CAT, XAT, NMAT, SNAP, MAT, and premier AICTE-approved PGDM & MBA programs.
- **URL**: https://collegecorridor.com/management-admissions

### 4. Law Admissions
- **BA LLB & LLM**: Guidance for CLAT, AILET, LSAT India, SLAT, and top National Law Universities (NLUs) & private law schools.
- **URL**: https://collegecorridor.com/law-admissions

### 5. Allied Sciences & Specialized Admissions
- **Pharmacy & Nursing**: B.Pharm, Pharm.D, and B.Sc Nursing admissions.
- **URL**: https://collegecorridor.com/pharmacy-nursing
- **NRI Quota Admissions**: Direct NRI & Management quota admissions guidance.
- **URL**: https://collegecorridor.com/nri-admissions
- **Study Abroad**: Medical & Engineering admissions across MBBS abroad and international universities.
- **URL**: https://collegecorridor.com/study-abroad

---

## Core Advisory Services
1. **Profile & Rank Audit**: Real-time evaluation of NEET/JEE/CAT scores against historical cutoff trends.
2. **5-Year Fee & Budget Transparency**: Transparent fee audits detailing tuition, hostel fees, security deposits, and clinical exposure metrics.
3. **Round-Wise Counselling Strategy**: Systematic choice-filling strategy for MCC All India Quota and State Counselling authorities.
4. **Side-by-Side College Comparison**: Objective evaluation of hospital beds, OPD flow, faculty ratios, and campus infrastructure.
